Best Cinco de Mayo Celebrations in Phoenix

Old Town Scottsdale

The heart of the celebration with live music, street vendors, and authentic Mexican cuisine at venues like The Mission, Casa Amigos, and Maya Day + Nightclub.

Downtown Phoenix

Roosevelt Row comes alive with cultural celebrations, art walks, and authentic Mexican restaurants serving specialty menus.

Mesa

Large family-friendly celebrations with mariachi bands, folklorico dancers, and traditional food vendors.
